policy: Conservative whitelist of specific effects and their restrictions, not a complete or timeless color-pie classifier. Color access is preserved; power level and printability are not asserted. No off-color examples.

effects.text: Draw {amount_words} {cards}.
effects.color_pie_rule: Blue has unrestricted card draw.

effects.text: You draw {amount_words} {cards} and you lose {amount} life.
effects.color_pie_rule: Black draws cards with an additional life cost.

effects.text: Draw cards equal to the greatest power among creatures you control.
effects.color_pie_rule: Green card draw remains tied to creatures.

effects.text: [SELF] deals {amount} damage to any target.
effects.color_pie_rule: Red has unrestricted direct damage.

effects.text: [SELF] deals {amount} damage to target creature with flying.
effects.color_pie_rule: Green direct damage remains restricted to creatures with flying.

effects.text: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control.
effects.color_pie_rule: Green bite uses a creature's power and targets another creature.

effects.text: Target creature you control fights target creature you don't control.
effects.color_pie_rule: Green fight uses creatures on both sides.

effects.text: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
effects.color_pie_rule: Black has unrestricted creature reanimation.

effects.text: Return target creature card with mana value {amount} or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
effects.color_pie_rule: White's creature reanimation here is restricted to small mana values.

effects.text: Return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
effects.color_pie_rule: Blue recovers instants and sorceries to hand, rather than directly reanimating creatures.

effects.text: Return target card from your graveyard to your hand.
effects.color_pie_rule: Green can recover any card to hand.

effects.text: Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand.
effects.color_pie_rule: Blue returns permanents to hand.

effects.text: Counter target spell.
effects.color_pie_rule: Blue has unrestricted counterspells.

effects.text: Destroy target creature.
effects.color_pie_rule: Black has creature destruction.

effects.text: Exile target tapped creature.
effects.color_pie_rule: White removal retains a tapped-creature restriction.

effects.text: Destroy target artifact or enchantment.
effects.color_pie_rule: White and green can destroy artifacts and enchantments.

effects.text: Search your library for up to {amount_words} basic land {cards}, put {them} onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
effects.color_pie_rule: Green puts searched lands onto the battlefield.

effects.text: Add {red_mana}.
effects.color_pie_rule: Red can produce temporary red mana.

effects.text: You gain {amount} life.
effects.color_pie_rule: White has life gain.

effects.text: Target creature gets +{amount}/+{amount} until end of turn.
effects.color_pie_rule: Green can grant power and toughness together.
